body:
**Simple AutoSprint** is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft that automatically sprints whenever you move forward — no need to hold or double-tap Ctrl.

## Features
- Auto-sprint toggles on/off with **V** (rebindable in Controls)
- Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer
- Respects vanilla sprint restrictions (hunger, sneaking, etc.)
- On-screen notification when toggled
- Zero performance impact

## Installation
1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
2. Drop `file` into your `.minecraft/mods/` folder
3. Launch the game and press **V** to enable auto-sprint
